name: Kyouken Densetsu Crazy Knuckle II
original_name: 狂拳伝説クレイジーナックルII
source:
Lunar shadow was a legendary ultimate fighting school, but its last descendant lived 80 years ago. 
Kusakabe Aoma is a bouncer of the street gang group in the city called Crown City. But he wants to get to know his true self. One day he arrives to the usual place, but instead of smiles of other members all he sees is a sea of blood.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Our guy regain control in a room full of dead bodies. It seems he killed them all to protect the only other live person, a girl who became speechless due to shock. He is told to join a fighting tournament as a test. There, he met some friends that might help him regain lost memory. There seem to be a secret oraganization that is interested in him. Anyway, between story and H scene, you have to help him fight almost arcade style. During fights, you issue commands using the mouse in a 9 block square. With that, you can move, block, use AP to do attacks or charge up FP, neat. If you finish this game, you can also battle using/with any of the game chars that fight.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
「月影」曾是傳說中的終極格鬥流派，它最後一位傳人卻已是八十年前的人物。

草壁蒼馬是皇冠市某個街頭幫派的打手，卻一直想弄清真正的自己。一天，他照常來到幫派據點，迎接他的卻不再是同伴的笑容，而是一片血海。

[內容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

蒼馬在一間堆滿屍體的房間裡恢復意識。看起來，為了保護現場唯一還活著的少女，他親手殺死了其他所有人；少女則因驚嚇過度而失去了言語能力。有人要求他參加一場格鬥大賽，以此接受考驗。在那裡，他遇見了一些可能幫助自己找回記憶的朋友，似乎還有一個秘密組織對他極感興趣。

在劇情與性愛場景之間，玩家還得幫助蒼馬進行類似大型電玩格鬥遊戲的對戰。戰鬥時，玩家用滑鼠在九宮格中下達指令，可以移動、防禦、消耗AP發動攻擊，或積攢FP。破關後，還能操縱遊戲中任何參戰角色，或與他們交手。

[內容取自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
